description: BUPT-1 published altitude 487.607–494.651 km and inclination 97.3710 degrees. Semi-major axis and eccentricity use these altitude bounds with the configured WGS84 equatorial radius. RAAN, argument of periapsis and starting phase are unspecified by the source and default to zero; the archive start is an assumed element epoch. Two-body propagation is a configured display model, not a measured or reconstructed historical spacecraft position. Orbit edits do not change recorded telemetry.
